## What does this change?
A short summary and the reason for it. Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / block
- [ ] Example game, template or plugin
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup (no behaviour change)

## How was it tested?
- [ ] `node scripts/selftest.js` – 0 failed
- [ ] `node --check` on every changed JavaScript file
- [ ] Tried it in the app (Play panel / export / plugin) – describe what you did:
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording attached (for UI or game changes)

## Checklist
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (Added / Changed / Fixed)
- [ ] In-app docs / README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No `innerHTML` with untrusted text, no loosened sandbox, no new shell access, no telemetry
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or large binary files committed
- [ ] I have the right to share all code, art and sound in this PR, and agree it is released under **AGPL-3.0-only**
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Notes for the reviewer
Anything risky, unfinished or worth a closer look.
